requirements.title: Portable Agent Profile Adoption
requirements.description: System Monitor declares a scenario-owned, role-only Agent Manager profile and never exposes runner, model, or policy selection locally.

validation.notes: Verify System Monitor reconciles its declared profile source
Verify legacy runner/model inputs are absent from the consumer surface
Validate investigations request the reconciled profile key
Status retrieval remains lightweight without profile mutation
Portable role policy remains the sole model-selection authority
